verses.en: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.
verses.pt: E se sua oferta for sacrifício pacífico, se houver de oferecê-lo de gado vacum, seja macho ou fêmea, sem defeito o oferecerá diante do SENHOR:
verses.en_web: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings; if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And if his offering is given for a peace-offering; if he gives of the herd, male or female, let him give it without any mark on it, before the Lord.

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.pt: E porá sua mão sobre a cabeça de sua oferta, e a degolará à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho; e os sacerdotes, filhos de Arão, espargirão seu sangue sobre o altar em derredor.
verses.en_web: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.
verses.en_bbe: And he is to put his hand on the head of his offering and put it to death at the door of the Tent of meeting; and Aaron's sons, the priests, are to put some of the blood on and round the altar.

verses.en: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.pt: Logo oferecerá do sacrifício pacífico, por oferta acesa ao SENHOR, a gordura que cobre os intestinos, e toda a gordura que está sobre as entranhas,
verses.en_web: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
verses.en_bbe: And he is to give of the peace-offering, as an offering made by fire to the Lord; the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat on the inside parts,

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.pt: E os dois rins, e a gordura que está sobre eles, e sobre os lombos, e com os rins tirará o redenho que está sobre o fígado.
verses.en_web: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
verses.en_bbe: And the two kidneys, and the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away;

verses.en: And Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Arão farão arder isto no altar, sobre o holocausto que estará sobre a lenha que haverá encima do fogo; é oferta de cheiro suave ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: That it may be burned by Aaron's sons on the altar, on the burned offering which is on the wood on the fire: it is an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord.

verses.en: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
verses.pt: Mas se de ovelhas for sua oferta para sacrifício pacífico ao SENHOR, seja macho ou fêmea, oferecê-la-á sem mácula.
verses.en_web: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh is from the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without defect.
verses.en_bbe: And if what he gives for a peace-offering to the Lord is of the flock, let him give a male or female, without any mark on it.

verses.en: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.
verses.pt: Se oferecer cordeiro por sua oferta, há de oferecê-lo diante do SENHOR:
verses.en_web: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before Yahweh;
verses.en_bbe: If his offering is a lamb, then let it be placed before the Lord:

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
verses.pt: E porá sua mão sobre a cabeça de sua oferta, e depois a degolará diante do tabernáculo do testemunho; e os filhos de Arão espargirão seu sangue sobre o altar em derredor.
verses.en_web: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
verses.en_bbe: And he is to put his hand on the head of his offering and put it to death before the Tent of meeting; and Aaron's sons are to put some of its blood on and round the altar.

verses.en: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.pt: E do sacrifício pacífico oferecerá por oferta acesa ao SENHOR, sua gordura, e a cauda inteira, a qual tirará a raiz do espinhaço, e a gordura que cobre os intestinos, e toda a gordura que está sobre as entranhas:
verses.en_web: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the inwards, and all the fat that is on the inwards,
verses.en_bbe: And of the peace-offering, let him give an offering made by fire to the Lord; the fat of it, all the fat tail, he is to take away near the backbone; and the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat on the inside parts,

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.pt: Também os dois rins, e a gordura que está sobre eles, e o que está sobre os lombos, e com os rins tirará o redenho de sobre o fígado.
verses.en_web: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
verses.en_bbe: And the two kidneys, with the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away;

verses.en: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.pt: E o sacerdote fará arder isto sobre o altar; comida de oferta acesa ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: That it may be burned by the priest on the altar; it is the food of the offering made by fire to the Lord.

verses.en: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
verses.pt: E se for cabra sua oferta oferecê-la-á diante do SENHOR:
verses.en_web: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before Yahweh:
verses.en_bbe: And if his offering is a goat, then let it be placed before the Lord,

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
verses.pt: E porá sua mão sobre a cabeça dela, e a degolará diante do tabernáculo do testemunho; e os filhos de Arão espargirão seu sangue sobre o altar em derredor.
verses.en_web: and he shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
verses.en_bbe: And let him put his hand on the head of it and put it to death before the Tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron are to put some of its blood on and round the altar.

verses.en: And he shall offer thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.pt: Depois oferecerá dela sua oferta acesa ao SENHOR; a gordura que cobre os intestinos, e toda a gordura que está sobre as entranhas,
verses.en_web: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
verses.en_bbe: And of it let him make his offering, an offering made by fire to the Lord; the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat on the inside parts,

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.pt: E os dois rins, e a gordura que está sobre eles, e o que está sobre os lombos, e com os rins tirará o redenho de sobre o fígado.
verses.en_web: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
verses.en_bbe: And the two kidneys, with the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, let him take away;

verses.en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the LORD’S.
verses.pt: E o sacerdote fará arder isto sobre o altar; é comida de oferta que se queima em cheiro suave ao SENHOR: a gordura tudo é do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is Yahweh’s.
verses.en_bbe: That it may be burned by the priest on the altar; it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet smell: all the fat is the Lord's.

verses.en: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
verses.pt: Estatuto perpétuo por vossas gerações; em todas as vossas moradas, nenhuma gordura nem nenhum sangue comereis.
verses.en_web: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”
verses.en_bbe: Let it be an order for ever, through all your generations, in all your houses, that you are not to take fat or blood for food.
